insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Plan-dependent. Annexure C shows Base Sum Insured options (e.g., Optima Secure: 5/10/15/20/25/50/100/200 Lakhs). Final Sum Insured as per Policy Schedule.

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room rent limit shall be At Actuals unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
great.explanation: Room rent is covered at actual cost with no fixed limit, allowing you to choose any room type without restriction.

great.name: ICU Charges
great.quote: ICU limit (including ICCU) for bed charges shall be At Actuals unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
great.explanation: ICU and ICCU bed charges are covered at actual cost without any cap, ensuring full coverage for critical care stays.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: The restored Sum Insured can be used even for the same illness for which an admissible claim has been paid during the Policy Year and also for any other Illness covered under the Policy.
great.explanation: Sum Insured restoration applies even for the same illness within the policy year, providing extra coverage for recurring conditions.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: The Secure Benefit will be applicable only after exhaustion of Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: An additional Sum Insured buffer activates after the base limit is used up, offering enhanced financial protection for large claims.

great.name: Renewal Bonus
great.quote: On Renewal... a sum equal to 50% of the Base Sum Insured... will be added... This Cover will be applied irrespective of number of claims made under the expiring Policy.
great.explanation: Sum Insured increases by 50% on renewal even if claims were made, so your coverage grows without resetting after claims.

great.name: Air Ambulance
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify expenses incurred... towards Ambulance transportation in an airplane or helicopter for Emergency Care...
great.explanation: Emergency air ambulance transport is covered as per plan limits, helping in critical situations requiring urgent transfer.

great.name: Bariatric Surgery
great.quote: Expenses related to the surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulfil all the below conditions:
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered if IRDAI conditions are met, benefiting those needing obesity-related surgical treatment.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage...
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage, which is a standard waiting period in the market.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses and procedures are covered after 24 months, matching typical waiting periods for specific conditions.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident...
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents, which is a common initial waiting period.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization
good.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 60 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately prior to the date of admission.
good.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered up to 60 days before admission, helping cover diagnostic and treatment costs before hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization
good.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 180 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately post the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered up to 180 days after discharge, supporting recovery costs following hospital treatment.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Year on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
good.explanation: Home-based treatment requiring hospitalization is covered, providing flexibility for treatment outside hospitals.

good.name: AYUSH Treatment
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred... for Inpatient Care under Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy... up to the Sub-limit specified...
good.explanation: AYUSH inpatient treatments are covered subject to sub-limits, allowing coverage for traditional medicine systems.

good.name: Consumables
good.quote: Intravenous fluids, blood transfusion, surgical appliances, allowable consumables and/or enteral feedings.
good.explanation: Allowable consumables during hospitalization are covered, helping with essential medical supplies.

bad.name: No NCB
bad.quote: Cumulative Bonus shall be available only if the Cover is specified to be applicable in the Policy Schedule.
bad.reference: Section B.1 Base Coverage intro, Page 11
bad.explanation: No standard No Claim Bonus is guaranteed unless specified, so your Sum Insured may not increase automatically on claim-free renewals.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Def. 8. Co-Payment means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy...
bad.explanation: Co-payment is defined but the policy does not clearly state if any co-pay applies by default; check your Policy Schedule for details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
